title: Localized pricing toggle + deprecation banner assets for release notes
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Purpose: Produce a compact asset pack for the March release notes that demonstrates the new pricing toggle UI in the model catalog and a graceful localized deprecation banner. These assets will be used in: release notes, the quickstart onboarding modal, localized docs, and the console changelog banner.

Scope:
- Desktop + mobile screenshots showing pricing toggle set to 'Estimated cost' vs 'Developer-friendly token estimate'.
- Localized copies in en-US, de-DE, fr-FR, es-ES, ja-JP with layout QA for truncation.
- Deprecation banner variants: soft (30-day notice), hard (sunset page link) and compact inline notice for model cards.
- Annotated source artboards (Figma) with copy specs, spacing tokens, and accessibility contrast notes.

Design decisions so far:
- Pricing toggle uses a pill-style control instead of a dropdown to reduce friction on mobile. PM requested visible per-1k-token examples beneath the toggle; engineering asked that the secondary cost estimate be rendered client-side for performance. We agreed to show a precomputed estimate for common lengths (256, 1024 tokens) and a tooltip for custom lengths.
- Deprecation color: chose warm amber (#FFB84D) for soft notices to avoid implying a critical outage; reserve red for emergency deprecation flows.
- Compact banner: includes model icon, short line, and 'Learn more' link; expanded banner shows full timeline and migration suggestions.

Deliverables:
- 6 full-resolution PNG screenshots (desktop & mobile, light/dark).
- 10 localized PNGs (variants of the most common screen sizes).
- 1 annotated Figma file with symbols and styles ready for handoff.
- Exported design tokens (spacing, color, type) as JSON for engineering consumption.
- Short video/gif (6-8s) showing toggle interaction for release notes hero.

Acceptance criteria:
- All screenshots match the in-console layout at 1440px and 360px widths and are approved by PM and Eng.
- Localized text fits without overlapping UI in provided languages.
- Engineering dependency ENG-112233 confirms that precomputed estimates match runtime values or falls back gracefully.
- Assets uploaded to Drive and linked in the release PR.

Notes:
- Keep copy under 90 characters for banner short line.
- Add aria-label guidance on the toggle artboard for the accessibility docs.
